remarks: Cute and cozy three-bedroom ranch home in the ‘burg. This home is tucked away on a side street and is within walking distance of both schools and dining options. Inside, practicality and comfort abound with single-level living. The main entry point is through the front door and into the living room, which features a bay window that looks out into the front yard. Just off the living room is the formal dining room with sliding glass doors into the three-seasons room. The three-seasons room looks out over the back yard, the exposed beams give the room an expansive and grand feel, this room will be your favorite place to watch the seasons change. The eat-in kitchen has plenty of storage space, including a clever built-in bread box and a pantry cupboard. The room is spacious enough to add in a small dining table or a breakfast nook. The home has a total of three bedrooms, all offering closet space. The full basement is partially finished, with a bar room to expand your options for hosting. The basement also has a workshop space with multiple surfaces to support a project of nearly any scale. The home has an attached one-car garage, and there is also a shed in the backyard to store your lawn care equipment. The back yard is currently lush with summer greenery, and there is an almost-hidden pergola just behind the house, imagine adding a seating area here, it would be your favorite place to relax after a long day.
